title: Nice cheap sink mat that smells.
text:
Nice cheap sink mat that smells.. I really like this for my large sink, but this stinks. I have had this in right side of my sink since Feb 2; 2018, and after leaving it out
Side for a few days I thought the stink was gone..NO, then we have been having allot of rain, cold in Ca. Brought it outside again for over a week And finally there is some relief from the smell.

Btw, when I got this I washed it with commet, barkeepers friend, dishsoap, and baking soda, didn’t do a damn thing..
After almost two months, and putting it out side again in the cold weather my kids are saying this smell is better but not a 100%.
If you have a lung problem, asthma, I would pass on this sink mat.
I also thought this was silicone. No its not.

The darn thing is, I like the size and all of this mat, and the price.
You get what you pay for, nice sink mat that stinks.

product_metadata.title: iDesign Contour Sink Saver, Black
features: KITCHEN SINK PROTECTOR MAT: Protects the sink as well as dishware, flatware, glasses, pots, pans, and more from scratches and damage during washing and drying
FLEXIBLE OPEN DESIGN: Open design allows water to drain through the mat, and the flexible PVC material grips the sink so it stays in place while in use
VERSATILE DESIGN: Compatible with any type of sink including stainless steel, metal, and ceramic, and it can also be used in bathroom, laundry room, and utility sinks
MADE WITH DISHWASHER-SAFE PVC PLASTIC: Durable BPA-free PVC plastic construction stands up to every day use and is dishwasher safe for easy cleaning and care
IDEAL SIZE: Measures 14" x 16" x 0.12" with corners that curve up in smaller sinks and lay flat in larger sinks to provide a customized fit
description: Protect your kitchen sink in style with the iDesign Contour Sink Mat. This kitchen sink liner protects the sink as well as dishware, flatware, glasses, pots, pans, and more from scratches and damage during washing and drying. The open design allows water to drain through the mat, and the flexible PVC material grips the sink so it stays in place while in use. The versatile design is compatible with any type of sink including stainless steel, metal, and ceramic, and it can also be used in bathroom, laundry room, and utility sinks. The sleek black color with modern grid pattern adds a decorative touch to the sink, and it matches other items in the Contour collection (sold separately) to add coordination to your kitchen decor. Made with durable BPA-free PVC plastic, this sink mat stands up to every day use and is dishwasher safe for easy cleaning and care. Measuring 14" x 16" x 0.12", this flexible sink protector has corners that curve up in smaller sinks and lay flat in larger sinks, making it ideal for a variety of sink sizes. With iDesign by InterDesign, you can #LiveSimply every day.
